messages:
Chris: quick non-work thought  what if we do a tiny "gratitude chain" for the holidays? one short note of thanks to a teammate + optional sticker/small treat swap. low effort.
Mina: love this. short notes only please. virtual ok too (e-stickers or a Slack thread shoutout). :sparkling_heart:  
Lena: i'm in. can we make a simple sign-up so people aren't overwhelmed? maybe limit to 2 folks each so it's not a million envelopes.
Priya: i'll make a one-line signup form. maybe timezone-aware so remote folks can ship locally.
Omar: vote: emoji reaction to this message if you want to participate. i'll bring a tiny sticker stash for in-office drops. :smile:  
holiday-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Gratitude Chain Sign-ups close" Mon 5:00 PM PST.
Chris: sample note idea (keep it short):
```
Hey @name, just a quick thanks for always jumping in on rollouts. your calm saved me this year. happy holidays!
—chris
```
Mina: i love the sample! also can we add a permission tickbox on the form if people want their message posted in #random as a kudos collage? some might prefer private notes.
Priya: signup form: https://tinyurl.com/rw-gratitude-chain (name + 2 recipients max + in-office vs remote + ship ok? + post publicly?)
Omar: in-person drop rules (if you choose in-office):
```
Drop table: 2nd floor pantry
Drop window: Tue 10am-3pm
Label: "gratitude - [recipient name]" + sender
```
Lena: small ask  allergy/safety-friendly treats only (no unlabelled home-baked). plus a sticker-only option is valid.
Chris: also hey teams: if you'd rather do a mini meme instead of a note, that's allowed. keep it friendly. :sunglasses:  
Mina: can we have a tiny collage posted Wed with everyone's consent? i'll assemble 1-slide gratitude board.
Priya: shipping deadline for remote swaps (US): Mon EOD. i'll DM international participants with local options.
Omar: i reacted :thumbsup: — bringing glitter-free stickers.
Chris: perfect. i'll post final RSVP tally Monday morning and share drop details. stoked to spread a few tiny thanks. :seedling:
